dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem to be rather concerned about the Wild Hunt. Are you a Ratnik too?

dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: Haha, of course not! Surely you can tell from the clothes I'm wearing! I'm no Ratnik... and I'm definitely not brave enough to fight monsters like they do...

dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: I'm just your regular merchant who occasionally moves goods for Piramida and sources supplies the Ratniki might need, that sort of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Alena
dialogues.text: So, when I'm on the job, I ask about what they know about the Wild Hunt, so I know which roads to avoid and stay safe. I guess that's one perk I enjoy.
